artworks.title: Das Waldfräulein (The Lady of the Forest)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a scene with a dense canopy of foliage obscuring the horizon line. Trees and intricate branches dominate the composition. The art style features delicate lines, creating a textured effect. The color palette is monochromatic, emphasizing detailed line work. A couple sits near a water feature surrounded by vegetation and architectural elements. The background shows more trees and abstract elements blending together. Hints of structured scenes or architecture are faintly visible.

artworks.title: Dancing
artworks.medium: drypoint printed with plate tone on wove cream paper
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract sketch of a figure in a dynamic pose, with one knee raised and arms reaching out. The face is turned upwards, and the hair flows backward. The figure's clothing is suggested through flowing lines that wrap around the body. There are no visible objects or jewelry on the figure. The background is plain with a neutral, textured surface.

artworks.title: Refugee Family
artworks.medium: drypoint with aquatint printed with plate tone on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in motion. The scene features a procession of figures. On the left, a figure in a long flowing garment holds a child close, while another smaller figure beside them clutches what seems to be a doll. In the center, a figure appears to be pushing a cart laden with belongings. To the right, a figure is carrying a large bundle over their shoulder, with a determined stride. The overall composition utilizes strong, dark lines and shading to convey tension and urgency amidst an indistinct background.

artworks.title: Fishing on the Havel River
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint and open-bite on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a fisherman standing near the water's edge, with the horizon placed beyond the center line. A body of water stretches out towards the horizon, with low vegetation on the left partially obscuring a small boat. Indistinct landforms are visible on the horizon, suggesting distant shores. The artist's brushstrokes are loose and sketchy, giving the scene a sense of spontaneity and simplicity. The color palette is monochromatic, with various shades of grey and black creating a somber, tranquil atmosphere. The fisherman's posture is slightly slumped as he holds his fishing rod over the water, showing his focus on the activity.

artworks.title: Totenklage
artworks.medium: woodcut on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of cloaked figures surrounding an object in the center. It is created with bold black and white contrasts, giving it a stark appearance. The figures are rendered in heavy black, standing out against the white background. The composition is somber and conveys a sense of mystery or gravity.

artworks.title: Thunderstorm (Small)
artworks.medium: etching on laid cream paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a rural landscape. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, looking over the scene. Tall trees dominate the left side, against the sky. The etching style uses fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic, using shades of sepia and black. A pathway with two figures, possibly a woman and a child, is in the foreground. Farther away, fields and more trees lead to the horizon.

artworks.title: Oasis in the Desert
artworks.medium: drypoint and roulette printed in light brown on laid cream paper
artworks.description: This image shows a landscape with palm trees among rocks. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, looking down a gentle slope. The horizon is high in the picture. The image has a sketch-like quality with fine lines and shading to depict the landscape's contours. Two small figures are walking along a path between rocky outcrops. The color palette is muted with warm beige tones and earthy shades.

artworks.title: Evening in Fukagawa
artworks.medium: color lithograph in blue, black, brown and yellow on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, showing a comprehensive view of the scene below. The horizon is high in the composition, with a dark silhouette of a traditional building and trees dominating the lower half of the artwork. The sky is painted in deep, textured blue tones implying a night or twilight setting with subtle brushstrokes for depth. The color palette is dark and moody, with muted greens and browns, contrasting with a bright glow of yellow light from a window. The textured brushwork creates a sense of stillness and quiet, enhancing the serene night-time ambiance.

artworks.title: View of the Interior of the Church of St Sebald in Nuremberg
artworks.medium: two-toned lithograph on wove cream paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of the interior of a grand cathedral with high vaulted ceilings and ornate architectural features. The drawing showcases an intricate Gothic style, with pointed arches and detailed stonework. The interior features columns supporting the arched ceiling and side aisles with large stained glass windows. Near the center is an ornate pulpit or altar area. The composition has strong linear perspective, leading the eye towards the far end where more architectural details can be seen. The attention to detail in the architectural elements is evident through fine line work and perspective.

artworks.title: View of the Castle of Olevano
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape seen from a high vantage point. Shrubs and trees are visible in the foreground, leading to rolling hills and a tower in the middle ground. The sky is filled with clouds, and mountains can be seen in the distance. The painting is detailed and textured with a monochrome palette of grey and black.

artworks.title: Sailboats in the Harbor
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid cream paper
artworks.description: The image shows bold, thick black lines and shapes against a light background. The abstract forms suggest the silhouette of a sailboat, with triangular shapes resembling sails and linear elements hinting at masts and rigging. The lower portion of the composition features wavy lines and shapes resembling water reflections, enhancing the nautical theme.

artworks.title: The Magi
artworks.medium: woodcut on wove paper
artworks.description: The image displays bold, expressive lines and sharp contrasts in black and white, forming an abstract composition. Three figures are depicted, each suggesting a regal figure with crowns on their heads. The figures hold objects resembling gifts or containers. The background consists of swirling lines.

artworks.title: Cat and Mouse
artworks.medium: linocut on wove cream paper, attached to a heavy wove support sheet
artworks.description: The image contains sweeping curved shapes and jagged, irregular lines in black and beige. Central shape resembles a horse silhouette with elongated limbs. Surrounding shapes resemble foliage or waves. Bold contrast between dark areas and light negative spaces.

artworks.title: Nude Girl Lying on a Sofa
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in black
artworks.description: This print depicts a stylized, abstract human figure with light skin reclining on a patterned couch. Their head is in the upper left corner, resting on one arm of the couch, and the rest of their body stretches towards the right, with their long legs crossed and extended down to the floor. Their head is small compared to the rest of their body, and their facial features are drawn with simple lines. Their hair isn't visible. The person is nude, with their arms crossed across their chest. Most of what we see is their stomach and long, crossed legs. The couch is pattered in bold, zigzagging black and white stripes with small black dots. The floor and wall are both black, with some white vertical lines in the top left suggesting a window obscured by blinds, or perhaps a piece of furniture. Below the print, a name is signed in gray pencil on the beige paper.

artworks.title: Woman Lying on a Sofa
artworks.medium: woodcut printed in black
artworks.description: The image depicts a stylized figure of a person reclining on a patterned chaise lounge. The figure is in a relaxed, semi-recumbent pose with abstract facial features, straight hair, and appears nude except for implied drapery over the lower body. Surrounding the figure are decorative elements, such as multiple human forms and vertical striping, hinting at a complex interior space.

artworks.title: Head of Dr. Bauer
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint printed in black with yellow monotype wiping
artworks.description: The sketch features a person's head and upper torso in profile facing right. The face shows closed eyes, a nose, and a mouth with simple lines. The hair is drawn with sketchy lines and shading. The clothing is not detailed. The background is a textured gray surface with shading and sketch lines.

artworks.title: Flood (Sintflut)
artworks.medium: woodcut with brown watercolor on gray-green wove paper
artworks.description: The image features swirling lines and shapes creating an abstract composition in black and reddish-brown colors. The arrangement resembles figures intertwined, with lines extending outward suggesting motion and texture.

artworks.title: Portrait of Arthur Roessler
artworks.medium: drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: This image depicts a drawing of a man shown from the shoulders up, in a partial profile view facing to the right. The man has defined facial features, short neatly combed hair, and is wearing a plain garment. He has both hands raised in the foreground with fingers spread apart and palms facing outward. The background is plain. The drawing is executed with fine lines.

artworks.title: DHMHTHP (Demeter)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on cream japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman reclined in a lateral position, with her head resting on her left hand. She has closed eyes, a relaxed expression, and long flowing hair. She is wearing a dark, patterned garment with a lighter-colored inner lining visible at the sleeves and neckline. The setting includes various flowers and plants, including daisies and tall grasses. The background is filled with more vegetation, including mature wheat stalks. The image is framed, with a decorative border that includes Greek lettering at the bottom.

artworks.title: Self-Portrait (sketching in his studio)
artworks.medium: etching with drypoint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is an etched portrait of a man seated on a chair. The man has a rugged facial appearance with prominent facial hair and short, wavy hair. He is dressed in a suit with a jacket and trousers, along with a bow tie. He is holding something in his hands, and appears to be focused on it. The background has vertical and diagonal lines, creating a textured, indoor setting, with some furniture sketch details visible.

artworks.title: Camel Rider
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove cream paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a desert scene. The image shows a group of riders and their mounts in motion, against a textured background. Several animals, possibly camels, are depicted racing forward with riders on their backs. The drawing is done in a loose, expressive style, with energetic lines that convey movement. The figures show determination and focus. Shadows and shading are used to give form to the figures, while the background remains minimalistic.

artworks.title: Forellenweiher (Trout Pond)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on laid cream paper
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a body of water with trees along the water's edge. The brushstrokes are dense and textured, creating shadows and light reflecting on the water. The color palette consists of dark, muted tones with blacks and grays. The water reflects the trees and sky, with darker tones in the foreground and lighter tones in the background.

artworks.title: Houses
artworks.medium: drypoint on laid cream paper
artworks.description: The image displays an intricate array of vertical and diagonal lines forming an abstract depiction of a narrow street or alleyway with towering structures on either side. The lines convey the texture and form of buildings, with vertical strokes indicating walls or facades and diagonal and curved lines suggesting rooftops and shadows. The composition creates depth and perspective akin to an urban canyon or clustered cityscape, connecting architectural forms with light and space.

artworks.title: Einsame
artworks.medium: etching on laid buff paper
artworks.description: The image displays a series of intricately etched lines forming an array of angular and curved shapes. This abstract composition features patterns that resemble faces hidden within the design, with eyes and mouths discernible amidst the swirling lines. The overlapping lines and shading enhance the abstract nature, guiding the viewer's eye through a maze-like pattern.
